title: Search
description: Full-text search in the index your product keeps for each tenant.

pick.title: Choose a tenant
pick.body: Every tenant has its own search index. Pick one to search it.

start.title: Enter a search
start.body: All words must match, in the title or the text. Search finds whole words, not parts of words.

syntax.all: finds documents that contain both words

noAccess.title: You cannot search this tenant
noAccess.body: Searching needs the permission search:query in this tenant. Ask an owner or admin of the tenant for a role that includes it.

form.label: Search the tenant’s index
form.queryHelp: Words, “quoted phrases”, or, and -word to exclude. At most 500 characters.
form.kindsHelp: Optional. Only documents of these kinds, separated by commas.
form.kindInvalid: “{{kind}}” is not a valid kind: use lowercase letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores, starting with a letter.

results.heading: Results for {{query}}
results.emptyBody: Check the spelling, use fewer words or whole words (search does not match parts of words). The index contains only what your product has indexed for this tenant.
results.emptyKinds: Nothing of these kinds matches. Remove the kind filter, check the spelling or use fewer words.

document.title: Indexed document
document.noBody: This document has no text, only a title.
document.derived: The index is a copy that your product writes. Changes to the original object reach the index only when the product indexes it again.
document.removeBody: The document {{kind}} {{ref}} no longer appears in search results. The original object in your product is not changed; the product adds it again the next time it indexes the object.
